_readme: Stage A: layers x dim. Stage B: LightGCN lr x reg.
After stage A, if the best LightGCN (layers, dim) differs from 2/64, edit stage B to use them.
If you change the settings of an experiment, change its name too (finished runs are skipped by name + settings).
HPO runs are selected on VALIDATION only. Test is touched only by --final.
